description: This file contains utility classes and functions for handling interactions with Databricks API within the litellm project. It defines exceptions, base utility methods for obtaining API base URLs, credentials, and environment validation specific to Databricks, including handling of missing configurations and environment variables.

classes.name: DatabricksException
classes.description: A custom exception class for Databricks-related errors, extending the BaseLLMException.

classes.name: DatabricksBase
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to construct API URLs, credentials, and validate environment configurations for Databricks API integrations.

methods.name: str _get_api_base(self, api_base: Optional[str])
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL, initializing the databricks SDK client if necessary.

methods.name: Tuple[str,dict] _get_databricks_credentials( self, api_key: Optional[str], api_base: Optional[str], headers: Optional[dict] )
methods.description: Obtains the API base URL and headers containing credentials, initializing the databricks SDK client.

methods.name: Tuple[str,dict] databricks_validate_environment( self, api_key: Optional[str], api_base: Optional[str], endpoint_type: Literal["chat_completions", "embeddings"], custom_endpoint: Optional[bool], headers: Optional[dict], )
methods.description: Validates and sets up the environment for making API calls to Databricks, raising errors if required credentials or URLs are missing.
